tweets.text: I knew we could unlock much better performance from the vintage macs by running Omarchy on them, but I didn't realize it was possible with the M chip generation too! So cool.
tweets.forward:
by @dhh: Linux now beats macOS on Apple silicon GPU memory bandwidth.

M1 Max, Omarchy:
macOS: 361 GB/s
Linux before: 241 GB/s
Linux now: 368 GB/s

The kernel never told the power controller the GPU was busy. One bit fixed it. https:// github.com/omacom/linux-a urora/pull/334 …
